interaction.prompt: You are the centre. Your D is retrieving the puck under heavy forecheck pressure. Tap where you should go to support.

feedback.right: Drop low to the strong side, just up the wall from your D, and give them a short, safe outlet they can actually make.
feedback.wrong: Flying the zone or drifting away leaves your D with no short outlet under pressure. Come low to the strong-side wall and show your blade for a pass they can actually make.

tip: Read your D before you take off. If they are getting squeezed, come low and show your blade.
why: Reading the defenceman's pressure before bolting up ice keeps a short outlet available, so the breakout starts with a completion instead of a forced long pass.

mc.stem: You are the centre and your D is retrieving the puck under heavy forecheck pressure. Where do you go to give them a safe outlet?
opts: Drop low to the strong-side wall, just up from your D, for a short, safe outlet
Fly the zone to the far blue line and ask for a stretch pass
Swing to the weak side and circle back high
Go to the front of your own net and wait
